description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsData' that extends 'BaseChangeableOpenmrsData' and implements 'FormRecordable'. It provides methods for managing form namespace and path data, including static utility methods to parse and construct form namespace and path strings. It is part of the OpenMRS core API, facilitating the linkage between data entities and form record information.

classes.name: BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsData
classes.description: An abstract class that manages form namespace and path data, integrates with the OpenMRS data model, and provides utility methods for parsing and constructing form namespace/path strings.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the form namespace and path string.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath
methods.description: Returns the path part of the form namespace and path string.

methods.name: setFormField
methods.description: Sets the form namespace and path string based on separate namespace and path inputs.

methods.name: getFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Constructs a combined namespace and path string with validation.
